entities.summary: Afrasiyab Badal bey oghlu Badalbeyli was a Soviet Azerbaijani composer, with noble Iranian origins, conductor and music critic, author of the music and libretto of Giz Galasi, the first Azerbaijani ballet and the first ballet in the Middle East.
